text:
Type: white wooden stool
Use: extra seating at a table, perch, footrest; dining room, kitchen, bedroom, hallway
Style: farmhouse, traditional, Scandinavian
Materials: solid wood with a white painted finish
Colors: white, soft white
Shape: rectangular seat with rounded corners over a plain apron, four splayed square legs, X-shaped cross braces on both sides, sturdy, compact
Feel: homely, fresh, cottage-like, sturdy
Goes with: white or wood dining tables, pale walls, linen, light wood floors; farmhouse kitchens, country or Scandinavian dining rooms
